remarks: Welcome to this beautifully appointed condo located in the heart of Greenwich. Unit 3B offers a bright and modern living space with an open layout, high ceilings, and large windows providing excellent natural light throughout. The unit features a well-designed kitchen with quality finishes, spacious living and dining areas, and comfortable bedroom(s) ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Additional highlights include assigned parking, private storage, ample closet space, and convenient laundry facilities located within the building. The well-maintained building offers premium amenities including a fitness center and secure common areas. Ideally situated just steps from downtown Greenwich, Metro-North, shopping, dining, and parks, this home delivers luxury, convenience, and low-maintenance living.
